faqs.a:
Tank load water is supplied only from city operated fill stands. Tank load water is
               a special service the city provides to customers to meet temporary water needs and
               unusual circumstances. Water supplied is metered automatically at the fill stand to
               each customer. Filling hoses are to be provided by each customer. Tank load water
               rates are set forth in
section 102-175
.
(Code 1981, § 33-43.2; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988;
Ord. No. 4184, § 1, 10-19-2009
;
Ord. No. 4305, § 6, 11-14-2011, eff. 1-1-2012
)
